name: Dloudos
stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Prisma, Pterodactyl, Cloudflare Zero Trust, PM2

en.summary: A game-server hosting platform built on a Pterodactyl fork. I added per-node isolation, Zero Trust admin access, and encrypted offsite backups that are proven by restore rehearsals.
en.role: Product owner and architect. I set scope, security and rollback gates, and decide what is safe to ship.
en.built: With Claude Code: about three in four commits are co-authored by it. I write the specs and the gates, and I measure before accepting an agent’s finding. Several were refuted that way.
en.figure: Simplified design diagram, not a live system map. Hostnames and network layout are left out on purpose.
